label: FUJICHROME Velvia 100 Professional [RVP100]
source: FUJIFILM Product Information Bulletin, FUJICHROME Velvia 100 Professional [RVP100], Ref. No. AF3-202E (EIGI-05.2-FG(HB)-5-1), curves read from the PDF's vector paths (page 8)

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity as charted on the chart's own labelled axis (sensitivity = reciprocal of the exposure in J/cm2 required to produce density 1.0 above D-min)

dye_density.unit: spectral diffuse density, absolute as charted (separated-exposure dye curves, each charted with its peak at about 1.0)

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by FUJIFILM. All three charts on page 8 are vector paths; curves read from the PDF's Bezier segments (sampled densely), axes calibrated piecewise on the drawn grid lines (tick labels are outlined glyphs; values assigned to grid lines from the rendered labels). The sensitometry chart frame sits 0.3-0.6 pt off the regular grid spacing, so the frame was not used and the 0.0/4.0 density and -3.5 log H edges are linear extrapolations of the inner grid lines. Characteristic curves (section 21): exposure daylight (no exposure time printed), process E-6/CR-56, densitometry Status A. Legend: R solid, G dash-dot, B dashed. Curves resampled every 0.02 log H. Spectral sensitivity (section 22): process E-6/CR-56, Status A, density 1.0 above D-min; y axis is labelled 'Relative Sensitivity* (log)' with ticks -1.0, 0.0, 1.0 and values are recorded on that axis as charted. Spectral dye density (section 24): exposure 'Separated', process E-6/CR-56; separate yellow, magenta and cyan curves are recorded; the chart has no 700 nm label (grid line at 700 nm inferred from the even 100 nm spacing). rms_granularity is the single printed Diffuse RMS Granularity Value (section 19: 8; read at a gross diffuse visual density of 1.0, 48 um aperture); no granularity curve is published. No reference exposure, 18% grey aim or normal-exposure mark is given anywhere in the bulletin, so no log_h_ref is recorded and x stays absolute log H. No mid-scale neutral or minimum-density spectral curve is published. Not recorded (no field in this schema): MTF curve (section 23), resolving power (80 lines/mm at 1.6:1, 160 lines/mm at 1000:1). viewing D50: the bulletin (section 11) asks for an ISO 3664:2000 transparency viewer, CIE illuminant D50, 5000 K. Tiny reversals in the drawn characteristic paths removed with a running minimum (largest change 0.0028 D).

scan.note: fitted to 96 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871922993-fuji-velvia-100/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
